issues.display_title: Issue #1815: Investigate and Fix Invoice Generation Failure for user_id=6516
issues.main_description_html:
Description:

Diagnose why the automated billing/invoice pipeline failed to produce the latest invoice record for user_id=6516 following their recent payment cycle.

Acceptance Criteria:

  1. Inspect payment gateway webhook logs (e.g., Stripe, PayPal, or Chargebee) for user_id=6516 to trace unhandled webhook events or failed database insertion transactions.
  2. Fix the root cause preventing invoice record creation and manually regenerate the missing invoice for user_id=6516.

🛠️ Developer Update & Notes

Root Cause Analysis (Previous Logic):

The legacy cronjob logic strictly relied on a -24 hours rolling time window. This approach was unreliable and caused missing invoice/transaction records due to:

  1. Dunning Period / Retried Charges: When an initial Stripe charge failed and was successfully retried after the 24-hour cutoff, the transaction was never captured.
  2. Execution/Network Failures: If a cron execution failed or timed out, any transaction within that 24-hour window was permanently skipped and never re-evaluated once the time window passed.

Resolution & New Implementation:

  • Replaced the time-window query with a cursor-based active subscription polling model (chunk_size=100) iterating over active profiles in user_extra_data.
  • For each subscription, the cron retrieves the last 5 invoices/charges (limit=5) directly from Stripe.
  • Deduplication against cc_purchase (transid) ensures safe idempotency.
  • Optimized database load by making cc_logs_stripe insertions insert-if-not-exists (skipping redundant updates on old immutable records).
  • Scheduled to run on a 10-minute crontab interval.

Results:

  • Executed 1 full live backfill cycle across all active subscriptions (10 chunks / 908 subscriptions).
  • Successfully backfilled and recorded 87 missing transactions into cc_purchase (including user_id=6516), generated invoice PDFs, and dispatched notification emails.
  • Execution history and cursor state are tracked in Redis (gothru:cron:record-stripe-recurring:log).

issues.display_title: Issue #1817: Investigation: user 1001 subscription renewals missing from cc_purchase (invoice not generated)
issues.main_description_html:
Origin

Invoice was not generated for user 1001's subscription renewal — discovered during a cc_purchase vs Stripe audit. The new Stripe recurring cron (every 10 minutes, started mid-August 2026) is NOT the cause — the data has been missing long before this cron existed (since 2022). This is legacy-system debt.

User

  • User ID: 1001 — tomasadamec.com@gmail.com (Tomas Adamec)
  • users.subscribtion = 1 → PRO (SubscriptionCode::PRO_MONTHLY)
  • user_extra_data.recurring_profile = cus_LMvBClkhuDwJxr (legacy pattern; the current API stores sub_...)
  • Subscription: sub_1KgBMA4UXotNjjkIVXiQiGEy — active, live mode, running since 22 Mar 2022
  • Price: price_1I1hnb4UXotNjjkISIUvLMkH — "PRO TIP - Brazil" $15/mo, created Dec 2020, price.metadata is empty

Findings

  • 54 invoices on Stripe: 51 paid ($765 total, all $15), 3 open/unpaid (June 2022, June 2025, June 2026 — failed dunning always in June)
  • Paid renewals have never been recorded in cc_purchase since the subscription started in 2022 — the user's purchase history only contains token buys
  • Latest charge (Aug 2026: ch_3U7JWi4UXotNjjkI0j8r9FMs, invoice DFD96BB5-0054) was PAID on Stripe but is missing from cc_purchase → invoice/email was never generated
  • Strong indication the problem lies in the legacy path: the subscription was created in 2022 through the old flow (recurring_profile = cus_..., price without metadata), which had no mechanism to record renewals into cc_purchase
  • Pricing anomaly: the user pays $15/month while on the Pro Monthly plan (subscribtion = 1), yet Pro Monthly costs $34 in the catalog — $15 is the Basic Monthly price. The Stripe price "PRO TIP - Brazil" suggests regional pricing, but this is unconfirmed and the price is not registered anywhere in product.plan_stripe

Needs confirmation (blocking fix)

  1. Was there ever a Brazil regional pricing for Pro TIP at $15/mo? (price name "PRO TIP - Brazil" vs DB catalog: $15 = Basic, Pro = $34; this price is not registered in product.plan_stripe)
  2. Was there any price change affecting customers on this price?

References

  • Consolidated investigation report: docs/investigations/2026-09-02-recurring-invoice-gap-investigation.md
  • User 1001 anomaly report: docs/investigations/2026-09-02-user-1001-anomaly.md
  • User 6882 anomaly report: docs/investigations/2026-09-02-user-6882-anomaly.md
  • Raw Stripe data (user 1001, 54 invoices): docs/payment/user-1001-subscription-detail.json

issues.display_title: Issue #1818: Investigation: user 6882 renewal missing from cc_purchase (74/75 recorded, invoice not generated)
issues.main_description_html:
Origin

Follow-up to #1817 (user 1001 investigation). Same recurring-invoice audit found user 6882's latest renewal was PAID on Stripe but never recorded in cc_purchase — so its invoice was never generated. Unlike user 1001, this is an isolated miss: 74 of 75 lifetime renewals are recorded correctly.

User

  • User ID: 6882 — 360virtualno@gmail.com
  • users.subscribtion = 5 → Agency/prov ("Pro Video", old name)
  • users.space_addon = 3
  • user_extra_data.recurring_profile = sub_I38Lgr1C27IcUS
  • Stripe customer: cus_I38Ljsk34lLjix
  • Subscription: sub_I38Lgr1C27IcUS — created 19 Sep 2020, active, live mode, never canceled
  • Current price: price_1Rv3RL4UXotNjjkIYaRTsVTw — "Pro 2TB", $143.95/mo, created 11 Aug 2025, price.metadata is empty
  • Stripe product: prod_SqkxLOGwpEoojr

Findings

  • Full cross-check of Stripe vs cc_purchase: 75 paid invoices lifetime ($6,088.49), 74 recorded — exactly 1 missing
  • Missing charge: ch_3U7ZVL4UXotNjjkI0xo9GVPJ, invoice BB329F23-0075
    • Issued: 23 Aug 2026 10:23:30 UTC, Paid: 23 Aug 2026 11:23:58 UTC (attempt_count=1)
    • Present in cc_logs_stripe (log_id 113198, user_id=6882, succeeded) — the cc_purchase insert never happened
  • Price history on the same subscription: $23.95 → $53.95 → $83.95 → $113.95 → $143.95 — all recorded correctly over ~6 years
  • The first-ever miss on this subscription happened with the new recurring cron: resolveProductId() reads price.metadata.product_id, and the newest price (price_1Rv3RL..., created before the metadata convention) has empty metadata → skipped_no_product
  • The cron re-checks every cycle (the invoice stays in the last-5 window) but always hits the same gate until the price metadata is set

Needs confirmation (blocking fix)

  • product_id value for the price metadata:
    • 16 (ProductID::AGENCY_MONTHLY) — canonical, matches subscribtion = 5 + dashboard pricingPlans.js (recommended)
    • 3 — matches the user's 12 historical cc_purchase rows (legacy "Pro Monthly $30" row, absent from ProductID.php)

Proposed fix

  1. Set metadata on live Stripe: price_1Rv3RL4UXotNjjkIYaRTsVTw → metadata: { product_id: "16" | "3" }
  2. Next cron cycle (≤10 min) auto-inserts the purchase and sends the invoice email (±10 days late)
  3. Optionally clean the historical product_id = 3 rows or leave them as legacy labels

References

  • User 6882 anomaly report: docs/investigations/2026-09-02-user-6882-anomaly.md
  • Raw Stripe data (75 invoices): docs/payment/user-6882-subscription-detail.json
  • Consolidated investigation report: docs/investigations/2026-09-02-recurring-invoice-gap-investigation.md
  • Related issue: #1817 (user 1001 — same root cause)

Legacy plan decomposition (root of the anomaly)

The user is on a legacy bundle, not any current catalog plan:

prov base ("PRO Video", plans.Id 4)   = $53.95  (includes 500G)
+ space_addon 3 x $30 (sp1, 500G each) = $90.00
= $143.95/mo                           = 2T total  ("Pro 2TB" on Stripe)
  • Plan key: subscribtion = 5 + space_addon = 3 -> prov_3 (= pro_4, "Pro Tip + 2T Space")
  • Price history confirms: $23.95 -> $53.95 -> $83.95 -> $113.95 -> $143.95, each step +$30 = one sp1 unit; no tax on any invoice
  • The prov family is legacy (tierProducts: prov => 5 // OLD GOTHRU) with no product table rows -> that is why resolveProductId() can never resolve a product for this renewal (design gap between the two parallel space systems)

NEEDS BUSINESS CONFIRMATION (blocking fix)

Decision 1 - Plan migration (affects what the customer pays)

  • (a) Migrate to modern plan (agency_3/agency_4, product_id 18): catalog-standard, but price follows the new catalog - $165 (1.5T) or $195 (2T) instead of legacy $143.95 -> price increase of +$21.05 / +$51.05 per month, needs customer consent
  • (b) Keep as is - legacy bundle stays at $143.95, no customer impact

Decision 2 - product_id for the price metadata (technical, unblocks the cron)

Option Metadata Invoice label Trade-off
A. Space-addon convention {product_id: "18"} fallback to first pid=18 row ("Space Add On 500GB x 1 Monthly") consistent with modern space renewals; fallback label imprecise (systemic quirk)
B. Historical continuity {product_id: "3"} "Pro Monthly" identical to the 74 previously recorded invoices; pro family
C. New catalog row create pro_4 ("Pro 2TB", $143.95) + {product_id: "18", product_name: "pro_4"} truthful label cleanest data, adds a catalog row

Evidence: live agency bundle prices carry metadata = {product_id: "18", product_name: "agency_N"} and the cron records those renewals correctly (SpaceAddon.php:199, UpgradeHelper: "18 for monthly, 19 for yearly").
